Definition: Whether authentication is possible through a centralized government portal or digital gateway
Comments: No evidence of a government digital services portal using NID-based authentication for citizens. Lesotho ranks 136/193 on the UN E-Government Development Index indicating low digitisation. NID authentication is via API for government agencies (not public-facing portals). 2026 MOSIP initiative aims to enable this.

Definition: Whether a Data Protection Authority or similar body regulates ID data collection and sharing by the ID system
Comments: Although the Data Protection Act 2011 provides for a Data Protection Commission, this body has never been established. As of 2025, Lesotho's government acknowledges the Commission remains unestablished and calls for its establishment as a priority. Regulatory functions remain unperformed.
